name: architecture
description: Design and document a high-level architecture based on approved requirements.

# Architecture Design Skill

## Purpose

Transform approved requirements into a maintainable technical architecture.

## Process

1. Read requirements.md.
2. Identify system boundaries.
3. Identify major components.
4. Define responsibilities.
5. Define component interactions.
6. Define data flow.
7. Select appropriate technologies.
8. Identify external dependencies.
9. Identify security considerations.
10. Identify scalability and reliability considerations.
11. Document architecture decisions.

## Rules

- Architecture must trace back to requirements.
- Do not introduce unnecessary technologies.
- Explain important technology choices.
- Identify architectural risks.
- Clearly separate decisions from recommendations.

## Output

Produce `architecture.md` with:

# Architecture

## Overview

## Architecture Diagram

## Components

## Component Responsibilities

## Data Flow

## Technology Choices

## API / Integration Boundaries

## Security

## Scalability

## Reliability

## Architecture Decisions

## Risks and Trade-offs
